name: Scott County, IA
findings: Scott County has 698 nonprofit organizations. 206 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 152 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Scott County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 12 youth organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 58 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
